class.name: StaggeredGridLayoutManager
class.brief_description: Masonry-style layout where each column stacks independently.
class.description:
StaggeredGridLayoutManager lays items into independent columns (masonry): each new item flows into the currently shortest column, so columns have different heights and items are staggered rather than row-aligned. Position and offset are non-monotonic (a later item may sit above an earlier one), and the visible range is resolved per column.
[b]Example[/b]: [codeblock] var layout := StaggeredGridLayoutManager.new() layout.set_span_count(2) recycler_view.set_layout(layout) [/codeblock] [b]Note:[/b] Android's gap strategy is not ported; there is no [code]set_gap_strategy[/code].

method.name: get_col_top_of_position
method.description: Returns the offset of the item within its column (0 when out of range).

method.name: get_item_column
method.description: Returns the column index of the item at [code]position[/code] (0 when out of range).

method.name: set_span_count
method.description: Sets the number of independent columns (minimum 1). Marks the layout dirty.
